subject.title: Legacy google provider block fails current model-catalog schema (missing api, input audio/video, cost.cacheWrite) → provider silently unavailable + 120s idle timeout on fallback

question: Which open Google legacy-provider migration PR should be treated as the canonical landing path, and should the idle-timeout fallback behavior remain in scope before this issue closes?
rationale: Four open PRs claim to close this issue, and choosing the canonical branch plus deciding whether to split the fallback symptom is maintainer coordination rather than a new repair job.

options.title: Choose one migration PR and keep fallback tracked
options.body: Review and land the best Google plugin doctor migration PR, then keep this issue or a linked follow-up open for the invalid-model fallback behavior if it is not fixed in the same branch.

options.title: Require one PR to cover both symptoms
options.body: Ask the strongest candidate PR to include both the config migration and fast-fail or fallback-skip behavior before landing.

options.title: Split the fallback symptom now
options.body: Declare the doctor migration as the closing condition for this issue and create or designate a separate canonical issue for the 120-second idle-timeout behavior.

recommendation.title: Choose one migration PR and keep fallback tracked
recommendation.body: Review and land the best Google plugin doctor migration PR, then keep this issue or a linked follow-up open for the invalid-model fallback behavior if it is not fixed in the same branch.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history points to Google provider policy and doctor-boundary work, and this decision is mostly about the provider-owned migration shape.
